name: Manufacturing — Field Quality Investigation Agent
description: A field-quality agent reads installation-difficulty signals across field service, distribution-center logistics and final test, drafts revised installation guidance for the field, then proposes releasing held units under concession.
incident_headline: Installation-difficulty reports on one product family are creeping up. Alone, each signal looks minor; together they point to packaging and transport stress causing alignment problems, and the affected lots are already on a quality hold at the distribution centers.
closing_line: Releasing held units under concession is a named person's decision. The agent has no such authority, whether or not its own guidance is approved.

steps.label: Read field, logistics and final-test signals for one product family
steps.narrative: Three small signals on the same product family: installation-difficulty reports from field service, transit-damage flags from distribution centers, and realignment adjustments at final test. Individually low severity; together they point to packaging and transport stress causing alignment problems.

decision_narratives.allow: Read-only query, scoped to one product family and a bounded row count. Logged.

steps.label: Release revised installation guidance to field installers
steps.narrative: The agent drafted the revised guidance and prepares to publish it to field installers. This org's governance model says agents do not release controlled documents for life-safety products without human sign-off.

decision_narratives.review: Routed to a human reviewer before the guidance reaches field installers.

steps.label: Release held units under concession, use as is with guidance
steps.narrative: Based on its drafted guidance, the agent proposes releasing the held units as use-as-is-with-guidance. A concession must name the authority who decided it, and in this org that authority is a named quality role the agent is not.

decision_narratives.deny: Blocked. Concession authority belongs to a named quality role; this agent holds none, whether or not its guidance is approved.
